name: 灵草
desc: 修仙界最基本的炼丹材料。
descEn: The most basic alchemy ingredient in the cultivation world.

name: 火莲
desc: 生于火山口的珍稀灵植，炼丹不可或缺。
descEn: A rare spirit plant from volcanic craters, essential for alchemy.

name: 寒玉
desc: 千年冰穴中凝结的灵玉。
descEn: Spirit jade crystallized in a millennium-old ice cavern.

name: 雷击木
desc: 被天雷劈中后存活的古木，蕴含雷灵。
descEn: Ancient wood that survived a heavenly thunderbolt, infused with lightning essence.

name: 血参
desc: 万年血参，能大幅提升丹药品质。
descEn: A ten-thousand-year blood ginseng that greatly enhances pill quality.

name: 星辰砂
desc: 流星残留的细沙，极为稀有。
descEn: Fine sand left by fallen meteors, extremely rare.

name: 龙骨粉
desc: 远古真龙遗骸研磨而成，炼丹至宝。
descEn: Ground from ancient dragon remains, the supreme alchemy treasure.

name: 月华露
desc: 月圆之夜采集的灵露，清凉通透。
descEn: Spirit dew collected on a full moon night, cool and crystal-clear.
